newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Suez Canal revenues slip in April.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Suez Canal revenues slip in April.

text.p: Egypt's revenues from the Suez Canal fell in April 1997 to $149.3 million from $153.7 million in March, official figures made available on Tuesday showed.
Revenues from the canal were $147.7 million in April 1996.

The number of ships which passed through the canal was also lower in April 1997 at 1,041 ships from 1,051 ships in March. Net tonnage in April was 30 million compared to 31 million in the previous month.

Income from the canal is one of Egypt's main sources of foreign currency. It is facing stiff competition from a pipeline which carries crude between the Red Sea and the Mediterranean and from the cheaper Cape of Good Hope route.
